text:
Key Features
Port: 1*DC12~48V input, 2*DC52.4V output, 2-pin connectors
Voltage step-up: boost DC12V/24V/48V to DC52.4V for IEEE802.3af/at/bt PoE devices(typically industrial PoE switches that receive DC48V~DC57V input)
Variable power output: DC12V~DC23V input supports Max 60W power output; DC24V~DC48V input supports Max 120W power output
Support 6KV surge protection and ESD: Air-15kV, Contact-8kV Protection
IP40 fan-less and Din-rail hardware design with compact size(85*85*30mm)
Operation temperature: -40 ℃ ~+75℃
It is an ideal solution for easy and efficient PoE equipment deployment such as PoE wireless access points or IP cameras in different industries and scenario
Specification
Product Name	120W Din Rail Industrial Power Adapter
Input Voltage	1*DC12V~DC48V
Input Current	5.7A 12V input, 60W output / 5.4A 24V input, 120W output / 2.7A 48V input, 120W output
Output Voltage	2*DC52.4V(±10%)
Output Power	60W: 12V input / 120W: 24 or 48V input
Connector	Removable 2 PIN Industrial Terminal Block
Reverse Polarity Protection	Support
Over-current Protection	Support, 7.5A Max
Protection Level	IP40(Currently IP66/IP67/IP68 rated models are NOT available)
Installation	Din Rail or Wall Mounted(1pc mounting hanger is offered)
Certification	CE/FCC/RoHS/Reach/UKCA
Working Environment	Working Temperature: -40℃~75℃ / Storage Temperature: -40℃~85℃ / Relative Humidity: 5%~95%, non-condensing
Industry Standard	Surge protection of power: IEC 61000-4-5 Level 3(4KV/2KV)(8/20us) / Surge protection of Ethernet ports: IEC 61000-4-5 Level 3(4KV/2KV) / (10/700us) / ESD: IEC 61000-4-2 Level 4(8K/15K) / Shock: IEC 60068-2-27 / Free fall: IEC 60068-2-32 / Vibration: IEC 60068-2-6
LED Indicator	PWR(Power indicator), Green Color / On: power status is normal
Off: power off or power connection failure
Mechanical Drawing
Packing Information
1pc power adapter(neutral device)
1pc wall hanger(shared holes with DIN Rail Kit)
Please know that there is NOT a user manual or warranty card in the packing box
Shipping box information(Below information is approximately accurate)
Product size: 85*85*30mm
Inner box size: 153*125*44mm
Product weight: 0.3Kg
Packing weight: 0.4Kg
Master box size: 385*385*325mm
Packing quantity: 48Pcs
Packing weight: 20Kg
Application
Solar power solution
Industrial automation & power control
Power boosting system
Typical Example
Background
In a solar power system, the generated voltage is between DC12V~DC24V
Different IP-based devices require power and data transmission
Wireless radio equipment
Camera
Difficulty
Most PoE switches received DC48V or above voltage to activate PoE function
Solution
STI-PA-120W-UP features below
Allow either DIN-rail or Wall mounting
Boost DC12V~DC48V to DC52.4V for powering PoE devices
Variable power output(60W or 120W), enough for powered IP-based devices
It could serve as an easy and cost-effective medium to transform low DC voltage to high DC voltage for transmitting power and networking signals on a PoE switch
In the meantime, it could be installed in any industrial Ethernet applications that requires voltage boosting such as
Vehicle network solution
Residential security system
Smart agriculture & healthcare
Industrial automation & IP communication
Its compact size((85*85*30mm, 0.3Kg) does not take up too much space while offering an easy and efficient power transformation solution
Product Picture
Remark
Please let us know if you need to check the PCBs
